## Hypothesis

The shotgun_scalper_stage4 grinder identified parameter combinations that improve wide P&L and win rate by adjusting exit thresholds (tighter stops, earlier profit targets) and entry filters (volume ratio, strike offset). The edge_capture of 506.55 suggests partial capture of J's winner days while limiting losses on loser days, but remains below the OP-16 floor of 771, indicating insufficient edge on the source-of-truth trades.

## Mechanism

**Entry:** 
- Strike: ATM + 2 (strike_offset=2) 
- Volume filter: vol_ratio_threshold=1.2 (current bar volume >= 1.2x 20-bar average VWAP volume)
- Time: No explicit time filter (inherits session gates)
**Exit:** 
- Take profit: exit when premium >= entry * 1.75 (tp_premium_pct=0.75) 
- Stop loss: exit when premium <= entry * 0.65 (stop_premium_pct=-0.35) 
- Time stop: forced exit after 12 minutes (time_stop_min=12) 
- Profit lock: chandelier arms at 0.6x entry premium (chandelier_arm_pct=0.6), trails 0.15 off high-water mark
- No re-entry filters beyond standard quality gates
